# Roasting

Roasting turns green coffee into the brown beans we grind. The roaster controls heat, airflow and time, and every batch is logged in [[roast-log]].

## Stages

1. Drying: moisture leaves the bean until it turns yellow.
2. Maillard: sugars and amino acids react and aromas develop.
   - The bean expands and the color moves to tan.
   - Most body is built here.
3. Development: the time after first crack that sets acidity.

## Profiles

Light profiles keep floral notes and are used for [[origins#Ethiopia|Ethiopian lots]]. Dark profiles mute acidity and suit [[espresso]].

> Never roast two origins in the same drum without a cleaning cycle.

Note: always check the drum temperature before charging.
